content: Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to sit independently for at least 5 minutes without support in 4 out of 5 opportunities, enhancing gross motor stability and postural control during play.

Within six months, Sabrina will reach across her midline to retrieve a toy placed 6 inches away, in 4 out of 5 opportunities, fostering bilateral coordination and crossing midline skills during interactive play.
Within six months, Sabrina will engage in a simple social play interaction, such as peek-a-boo, with a caregiver in 4 out of 5 opportunities, promoting social participation and play skills.
Within six months, Sabrina will explore different textures during sensory play using both hands in 4 out of 5 opportunities with minimal verbal cues, improving sensory processing and regulation.
Within six months, Sabrina will imitate playing pat-a-cake with a caregiver in 4 out of 5 opportunities with moderate assistance, enhancing social engagement and motor imitation skills.

Within six months, Sabrina will begin to tolerate brushing her teeth with a soft toothbrush, accepting physical assistance, in 4 out of 5 daily routines, supporting self-care and adaptive skills development.
Within six months, Sabrina will pick up small objects, like Cheerios, using a pincer grasp in 4 out of 5 opportunities with moderate assistance, advancing fine motor development and dexterity.
